# Official Source Library

## What this page does

Official Source Library stores official source document details and verbatim excerpts for review.

## When to use it

Use it when testing citation, source link, revision/currentness, and review tracking behavior.

## Before you begin

Have a safe official-source sample citation and excerpt. Use verbatim source text only when adding excerpts.

## Step-by-step instructions

1. Open `/official-sources`.
2. Add source name.
3. Add form, publication, or instruction title.
4. Add revision or effective date if available.
5. Add official source URL.
6. Add a clearly marked official source excerpt.
7. Review currentness warnings.
8. Click `Mark reviewed` when testing review tracking.

## What to check

- Citation appears.
- Source URL appears.
- Currentness warning appears when needed.
- Excerpts are labeled as official source excerpts.
- No interpretation or advice appears.

## Common messages or errors

- Missing citation details: add source name/title/link where available.
- Source may need review: verify current official source outside the app.

## What this page does not do

It does not interpret official sources, recommend action, or guarantee compliance.

## Privacy/safety notes

Official excerpts must be verbatim and cited. User is responsible for verifying applicability with official agency sources or qualified professionals.
